hypothesis: Replacing one in sixteen focused 4096-move blocks by uniform free-cell selection improves mean accuracy by at least0.1 percentage point at4194304moves per chain with zero wrong stops.
primary_statistic: Paired returned-board accuracy mixed16 minus focused, averaged over six seeds and10000sharedpuzzles at4194304moves per chain.
decision: Supported if paired two-sided 95% lower endpoint is at least +0.1 pp and zero wrong stops; falsified if upper endpoint is below +0.1 pp or a wrong stop occurs; otherwise inconclusive.
validation: 33 native-general/captured-general/captured-sparse checks per job with independent manual native mode schedule; mixed crosses two uniform blocks and returns to focused. Integer fields, energy and focus flags independently recomputed at checkpoints. Unchanged pinned kernels.
limits: Matched move caps are not identical actual work or wall time; uniform selection skips focus bookkeeping.
Inherited flop estimates assume the initial focused mode and are not a valid compute comparison for mixed schedules; report measured wall time descriptively.
The uniform-only arm and earlier checkpoints are descriptive; only mixed16 versus focused at4194304 is primary.
One fixed count graph and six search seeds, not independent training replication.
New follow-up slice belongs to the corpus used by the original reproduction.
budget_unit: Moves per chain; all arms have four chains.
focus_schedule: Zero-indexed block floor(t/4096): mixed16 uses uniform cell choice when block modulo16 is15, otherwise focused. Focused and uniform controls use their named mode at every block.
